artifacts.summary: Every linter suppression in the live tree now carries a site-local reason naming its linter, enforced by the new build-free C29 invariant check.

completion_data.completion_summary: Reduced the tree's 12 `set_option linter.* false` occurrences to 7, eliminating all 7 bare ones: five deleted after deletion trials measured they hid nothing, one removed by renaming `regionHistory`'s unused binder to `_f`, and two kept with in-source reason comments naming what their deletion trials showed. Added check C29 to scripts/check-module-invariants.sh -- build-free, comment-masked, `Tests/`-inclusive, with an upward walk past stacked `set_option ... in` lines, a 13-fixture self-test, and exit-2 anti-silence guards not suppressed by ENFORCE_C29=0 -- plus its MODULE_INVARIANTS.md row and a LEAN_STYLE_GUIDE.md rewrite of the snippet that modelled the shape C29 rejects. Negative-tested three ways; `lake build` green at 2660 jobs, full harness ALL CHECKS PASSED, warning budget unedited at zero.
